# Introduction

This document contains all analyses of the SymPortal Post-MED sequences obtained from coral skeleton core samples collected during the TARA Pacific expedition for the reconstruction of Symbiodiniaceae communities over time.    

# General aim

The overarching goal of this study was to evaluate the use of skeleton cores from massive coral species for the reconstruction of Symbiodiniaceae communities at decadal and centennial time scales across species and locations. For this, century-old coral skeleton cores were sampled from two massive species (*Porites lobata* and *Diploastrea heliopora*) from two locations in the Pacific (Papua New Guinea and Palau) and ancient Symbiodiniaceae community dynamics were analyzed using ITS2 amplicon sequencing. 

## Specific aims

**Aim 1 - DNA method effects:**    

Assess the effect of three different DNA extraction methods on the reconstructed Symbiodiniaceae communities.

**Aim 2 - Species x Location effects:**    

Evaluate changes in reconstructed communities obtained by species and sampling location.

**Aim 3 - Dynamics related to past environmental changes:**    

Probe differences in the reconstruction dynamics between two massive growing coral species in the context of past potential heat stress events. 

# Experimental factors

- **Sampling location:** 
  * Palau (sampled in 2017)    
  * Papua New Guinea (PNG - sampled in 2018)    

- **Species:**     
  * *Porites lobata* (1 core for each sampling location, 2 cores total)
  * *Diploastrea heliopora* (1 core for each sampling location, 2 cores total)    

- **DNA extraction method:** Only for the PNG Porites cores    
  * PowerSoil    
  * PowerSoil + EDTA    
  * Ancient DNA protocol    
  
- **Chronology:** 
  * Decadal scale (Pieces from 0 to 6)    
  * Century scale: 
    * Porites: Fragments 16, 17 & 18 (equivalent to 80, 85 & 90 year-old fragments)    
    * Diploastrea: Fragments 20, 21 & 22 (equivalent to 100, 105 & 110 year-old fragments)   

# Load data and packages

All packages that were employed for the analysis and visualization were loaded here

```{r Load packages}

#General data manipulation and visualization
library(tidyverse)

#Multivariate analyses
##Package for performing ordination, PERMANOVA and Betadisper
library(vegan)
##Package for performing pairwise comparisons for PERMANOVA
library(pairwiseAdonis)

#Data visualization packages
##Package for performing Upset plot
library(ComplexUpset)
##Package for joining ggplot-based plots
library(patchwork)
##Package to extract plot legends
library(ggpubr)
##Package for creating color palettes
library(ggnested)

```

The datasets were:

- **Metadata:** File containing the metadata of the cores and experimental factors    

- **Absolute_abundance:** File containing the Post-MED sequences    

- **NOAA_CRW:** File containing the Sea surface temperature (SST) and Number of days with bleaching alerts for Palau and Papua New Guinea along with additional environmental variables.    

```{r Load data}

##Sample Metadata
Metadata <- read.delim(file = "Data/Metadata.txt", header = T, sep = "\t", dec = ".")

##Absolute abundance of Post-MED sequences
Absolute_abundance <- read.delim(file = "Data/Absolute_Abundance.txt", header = T, sep = "\t", dec = ".")

#NOAA CRW data
NOAA_CRW <- read.csv(file = "Data/SST_NOAA_CRW_joined.csv", header = T, sep = ",", dec = ".")

```


# Data preprocessing

The main goal of this section was to prepare the datasets to perform data visualization and statistical testing.

## Create the complete, tidy dataset

The metadata file was modified to include additional relevant variables for downstream analyses including information related to coral genus, fragment age and DNA extraction method.    

```{r Metadata - Include useful variables}

#Create a clean dataframe 
Metadata_clean <- Metadata %>%
  #Select the relevant columns
  select(sample_uid, sample_name, post_med_absolute) %>%
  #Create new Metadata columns
  mutate(
    
    #Coral genera
    Coral_genus = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^P", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Porites",
                           grepl(pattern = "^D", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Diploastrea",
                           grepl(pattern = "^C", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Neg_Control",
                           grepl(pattern = "^G", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PCR_Blank_Seq"), levels = c("Porites", "Diploastrea", "Neg_Control", "PCR_Blank_Seq")),
         
    #DNA extraction method
    DNA_method = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "B$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil_EDTA",
                              grepl(pattern = "D$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil_EDTA",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Ancient_DNA"), levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA")),
         
    #Sampling location
    Location = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "B$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Palau",
                              grepl(pattern = "D$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG"), levels = c("Palau", "PNG")),
         
    #Number asociated with each fragment
    Fragment_label = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^[PD]0", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Head",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]1[^678]", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]2[^012]", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]3", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "3",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]4", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "4",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]5", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "5",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]6", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "6",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P16", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P17", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P18", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D20", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D21", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D22", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3"), levels = c("Head", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3")),
         
         #Age since sampling of each fragment
         Fragment_age = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^[PD]0", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "0",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]1[^678]", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "5",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]2[^012]", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "10",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]3", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "15",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]4", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "20",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]5", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "25",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]6", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "30",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P16", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "80",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P17", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "85",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P18", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "90",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D20", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "100",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D21", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "105",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D22", x = sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "110"), levels = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30", "80", "85", "90", "100", "105", "110"))) %>%
  #Rename the relevant columns
  rename(Sample_SymPortal_code = sample_uid, Sample_name = sample_name, Post_MED_sequences = post_med_absolute) %>%
  #Reorder the columns
  select(Sample_SymPortal_code, Sample_name, Fragment_label, Fragment_age, Location, Coral_genus, DNA_method, Post_MED_sequences)

```

To obtain a final dataset where the metadata and post-MED sequence abundance is present, the expanded metadata and absolute abundance datasets were joined.


```{r Creating working dataframe - Join Metadata and Abundance}

#Creating the long-format joined dataset
Abs_abund <- left_join(Metadata_clean, 
                             Absolute_abundance %>%
                               #Modify sample code variable name
                               rename(Sample_SymPortal_code = sample_uid), 
                             by = "Sample_SymPortal_code") %>%
  #Change the data structure to long format
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("Sample_SymPortal_code", "Sample_name", "Fragment_label", "Fragment_age", "Location", "Coral_genus", "DNA_method", "Post_MED_sequences"), names_to = "Symbiont_genus", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  #Create a new variable with the simplified Clades
  mutate(Symbiont_genus_simp = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^A|_A$", x = Symbiont_genus) ~ "A",
                                grepl(pattern = "^B|_B$", x = Symbiont_genus) ~ "B",
                                grepl(pattern = "^C|_C$", x = Symbiont_genus) ~ "C",
                                grepl(pattern = "^D|_D$", x = Symbiont_genus) ~ "D",
                                TRUE ~ Symbiont_genus), .before = "Symbiont_genus") %>%
  #Remove the SymPortal sample code
  select(-Sample_SymPortal_code)

```

The final step was verifying that all the information is present from both datasets

```{r Creating working dataframe - Join Metadata and Abundance - Verification}

#Verifiying that the information matches
all((Abs_abund %>%
  #Group the data by sample
  group_by(Sample_name, Post_MED_sequences) %>%
  #Obtain the total number of sequences by each Genus DIV
  summarize(Total_Abundance = sum(Abundance)))$Post_MED_sequences ==
  (Abs_abund %>%
  #Group the data by sample
  group_by(Sample_name, Post_MED_sequences) %>%
  #Obtain the total number of sequences by each Genus DIV
  summarize(Total_Abundance = sum(Abundance)))$Total_Abundance)

```

### Filter out blanks and negative controls

All post-MED sequences present in the processing blanks and negative controls were filtered out from the entire dataset.  

Example:    

|             	|        Blank       	|       Sample       	|  Corrected sample  	|
|:-----------:	|:------------------:	|:------------------:	|:------------------:	|
|             	| Symbiodinium (Adx) 	| Symbiodinium (Adx) 	|    NOT INCLUDED    	|
|             	|  Symbiodinum (A1)  	|  Symbiodinium (A1) 	|    NOT INCLUDED    	|
| Genus (DIV) 	| Symbiodinium (A15) 	|          -         	| Symbiodinium (A15) 	|
|             	|  Durusdinium (D3)  	|          -         	|  Durusdinium (D3)  	|
|             	|  Cladocopium (C15) 	|  Cladocopium (C15) 	|    NOT INCLUDED    	|



```{r Blank corrected dataset}

Blanks <- Abs_abund %>%
  #Filter to only obtain Blanks and the PCR names
  filter(grepl(pattern = "^C_|G_PCR", x = Sample_name)) %>%
  #Pre-filter to obtain abundances higher than 0
  filter(Abundance > 0)


G_PCR <- Blanks %>%
  #Filter the dataset to obtain only the desired sample
  filter(Sample_name == "G_PCR") %>%
  #Select the variables
  select(Symbiont_genus)


C_P_B <- Blanks %>%
  #Filter the dataset to obtain only the desired sample
  filter(Sample_name == "C_P_B") %>%
  #Select the variables
  select(Symbiont_genus) %>%
  #Include the PCR blanks
  left_join(G_PCR, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, PCR_Blank = Symbiont_genus.y)


C_P_D <- Blanks %>%
  #Filter the dataset to obtain only the desired sample
  filter(Sample_name == "C_P_D") %>%
  #Obtain the names of the Symbiont_genuss per blanks
  distinct(Symbiont_genus) %>%
  #Include the PCR blanks
  left_join(G_PCR, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, PCR_Blank = Symbiont_genus.y)


C_P_E <- Blanks %>%
  #Filter the dataset to obtain only the desired sample
  filter(Sample_name == "C_P_E") %>%
  #Obtain the names of the Symbiont_genuss per blanks
  distinct(Symbiont_genus) %>%
  #Include the PCR blanks
  left_join(G_PCR, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, PCR_Blank = Symbiont_genus.y)


C_P_F <- Blanks %>%
  #Filter the dataset to obtain only the desired sample
  filter(Sample_name == "C_P_F") %>%
  #Obtain the names of the Symbiont_genuss per blanks
  distinct(Symbiont_genus) %>%
  #Include the PCR blanks
  left_join(G_PCR, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, PCR_Blank = Symbiont_genus.y)


C_D_B <- Blanks %>%
  #Filter the dataset to obtain only the desired sample
  filter(Sample_name == "C_D_B") %>%
  #Obtain the names of the Symbiont_genuss per blanks
  distinct(Symbiont_genus) %>%
  #Include the PCR blanks
  left_join(G_PCR, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, PCR_Blank = Symbiont_genus.y)


C_D_E <- Blanks %>%
  #Filter the dataset to obtain only the desired sample
  filter(Sample_name == "C_D_E") %>%
  #Obtain the names of the Symbiont_genuss per blanks
  distinct(Symbiont_genus) %>%
  #Include the PCR blanks
  left_join(G_PCR, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, PCR_Blank = Symbiont_genus.y)


#________________________________________________________________________

PXB_adj <- Abs_abund %>%
  #Filter the samples to obtain the desired sample
  filter(grepl(pattern = "P\\dB|P\\d\\dB", x = Sample_name)) %>% 
  #Join with the corresponding blank
  left_join(C_P_B, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%

  filter(is.na(Symbiont_genus.y)) %>%

  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, Blank = Symbiont_genus.y) #%>%
  #Filter out the Symbiont_genuss with abundance of 0
  #filter(Abundance > 0)


PXD_adj <- Abs_abund %>%
  #Filter the samples to obtain the desired sample
  filter(grepl(pattern = "P\\dD|P\\d\\dD", x = Sample_name)) %>% 
  #Join with the corresponding blank
  left_join(C_P_D, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Filter out the rows with NAs as determined by the Blank
  filter(is.na(Symbiont_genus.y)) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, Blank = Symbiont_genus.y) #%>%
  #Filter out the Symbiont_genuss with abundance of 0
  #filter(Abundance > 0)


PXE_adj <- Abs_abund %>%
  #Filter the samples to obtain the desired sample
  filter(grepl(pattern = "P\\dE|P\\d\\dE", x = Sample_name)) %>% 
  #Join with the corresponding blank
  left_join(C_P_E, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Filter out the rows with NAs as determined by the Blank
  filter(is.na(Symbiont_genus.y)) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, Blank = Symbiont_genus.y)  #%>%
  #Filter out the Symbiont_genuss with abundance of 0
  #filter(Abundance > 0)


PXF_adj <- Abs_abund %>%
  #Filter the samples to obtain the desired sample
  filter(grepl(pattern = "P\\dF|P\\d\\dF", x = Sample_name)) %>% 
  #Join with the corresponding blank
  left_join(C_P_F, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Filter out the rows with NAs as determined by the Blank
  filter(is.na(Symbiont_genus.y)) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, Blank = Symbiont_genus.y) #%>%
  #Filter out the Symbiont_genuss with abundance of 0
  #filter(Abundance > 0)


DXB_adj <- Abs_abund %>%
  #Filter the samples to obtain the desired sample
  filter(grepl(pattern = "D\\dB|D\\d\\dB", x = Sample_name)) %>% 
  #Join with the corresponding blank
  left_join(C_D_B, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Filter out the rows with NAs as determined by the Blank
  filter(is.na(Symbiont_genus.y)) %>%
  #Rename the Symbiont_genus columns
  rename(Symbiont_genus = Symbiont_genus.x, Blank = Symbiont_genus.y) #%>%
  #Filter out the Symbiont_genuss with abundance of 0
  #filter(Abundance > 0)


DXE_adj <- Abs_abund %>%
  #Filter the samples to obtain the desired sample
  filter(grepl(pattern = "D\\dE|D\\d\\dE", x = Sample_name)) %>% 
  #Join with the corresponding blank
  left_join(C_D_E, by = "Symbiont_genus", keep = T) %>%
  #Filter out the rows with NAs as determined by the Blank
  filter(is.na(Symbiont_genus.y)) %>%

#Join all the separate datasets
Abs_abund_clean <- bind_rows(PXB_adj, DXB_adj, PXD_adj, PXE_adj, PXF_adj, DXE_adj) %>%
  #Select the relevant variables
  select(-c("Blank", "PCR_Blank")) %>%
  #Include the sample names as a factor
  mutate(Sample_name = factor(x = Sample_name, levels = c("P0B", "P1B", "P2B", "P3B", "P4B", "P5B", "P6B", "P16B", "P17B", "P18B", 
                                                               "P0D", "P1D", "P2D", "P3D", "P4D", "P5D", "P6D", "P16D", "P17D", "P18D", 
                                                               "P0E", "P1E", "P2E", "P3E", "P4E", "P5E", "P6E", "P16E", "P17E", "P18E", 
                                                               "P0F", "P1F", "P2F", "P3F", "P4F", "P5F", "P6F", "P16F", "P17F", "P18F", 
                                                               "D0B", "D1B", "D2B", "D3B", "D4B", "D5B", "D6B", "D20B", "D21B", "D22B",
                                                               "D0E", "D1E", "D2E", "D3E", "D4E", "D5E", "D6E", "D20E", "D21E", "D22E")), .before = Fragment_label)
  
#Remove temporary datasets
rm(Blanks, C_D_B, C_D_E, C_P_B, C_P_D, C_P_E, C_P_F, DXB_adj, DXE_adj, G_PCR, PXB_adj, PXD_adj, PXE_adj, PXF_adj)

```

Finally we updated the dataset to include the total count of Post-MED sequences after the blank correction

```{r Update the Abs-abund-clean dataset}

#Join both datasets
Abs_abund_clean <- left_join(
  Abs_abund_clean, 
  
  #Percentage of lost sequences per sample
  Abs_abund_clean %>%
  #Group the data by sample
  group_by(Sample_name, Fragment_label, Fragment_age, Location, Coral_genus, DNA_method, Post_MED_sequences) %>%
  #Obtain the total number of sequences per sample
  summarize(Post_MED_sequences_blank_corrected = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  #Ungroup the data
  ungroup() %>%
  #Create a new variable with the difference
  mutate(Lost_seqs_blank_correction = Post_MED_sequences - Post_MED_sequences_blank_corrected,
         Lost_seqs_blank_correction_perc = (Post_MED_sequences_blank_corrected/Post_MED_sequences) * 100),
  by = colnames(Abs_abund_clean)[1:7]) %>%
  #Sort the columns
  select(Sample_name, Fragment_label, Fragment_age, Location, Coral_genus, DNA_method, Post_MED_sequences, Post_MED_sequences_blank_corrected, Lost_seqs_blank_correction, Lost_seqs_blank_correction_perc, Symbiont_genus_simp, Symbiont_genus, Abundance)


```

## Calculate relative abundance over 0.1%

We proceeded to calculate the relative abundance of the samples. For this we employed the Post-MED sequences after blank correction

```{r Relative abundance over 0.1 dataset}

Abund_clean_rel_0.1 <- Abs_abund_clean %>%
  #Calculate the relative abundance
  mutate(Rel_abund = Abundance/Post_MED_sequences_blank_corrected,
         Rel_abund_per = (Abundance/Post_MED_sequences_blank_corrected) * 100, 
         .after = Abundance) %>%
  #Assign the sequences below 0.1% to a "Others" category
  mutate(
    #Create a new Symbiont_genus variable that contains the Others category
    Symbiont_genus_others = case_when(Rel_abund_per < 0.1 ~ "Others",
                               TRUE ~ Symbiont_genus),
    #Create a new Symbiont_genus_simp variable that includes the Others category
    Symbiont_genus_simp_others = case_when(Symbiont_genus_others == "Others" ~ "Others",
                                    TRUE ~ Symbiont_genus_simp) )


```


## Assign colors to each Genus DIV

We proceeded to pre-assign a defined color to each DIV present in the **blank-corrected** dataset as it represents the most complete data that we will employ. By assign a color to each post-MED sequence (DIV) we can ensure a uniform color distribution in all analyses (for example all bar plots).    

In order to assign the colors for each main symbiont genus, we employed the package **ggnested**, which allows us to assign a main color palette for each symbiont genus and it can automatically assign a gradient for all the DIVs present in a genus.    

For further references for the color palette check: https://github.com/gmteunisse/ggnested    

- **Symbiodinium**: "#F0E442"    

- **Breviolum**: "#0072B2"    

- **Cladocopium**: "#CC79A7"    

- **Durusdinium**: "#202A2"    

- **Others** color: "#bbbbbb"    


```{r Assign colors to each Genus DIV}

#Extract the color codes
Color_palette_Symbiont_genus <- ggnested::extract_palette(Abs_abund_clean %>% ggnested::ggnested(aes(x = Sample_name, y = Abundance, main_group = Symbiont_genus_simp, sub_group = Symbiont_genus), main_palette = c("#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#202A25"), gradient_type = "fancy", min_l = 0.25, max_l = 0.95) + geom_col( show.legend = F) ) %>%
  #Obtain unique columns for Symbiont_genus and Symbiont_genus_simp
  separate(col = group_subgroup, into = c("Symbiont_genus_simp", "Symbiont_genus"), sep = " - ", remove = F) %>%
  #Rename variables
  rename(Symbiont_genus_combined = group_subgroup, Symbiont_genus_simp_color = group_colour, Symbiont_genus_color = subgroup_colour)

```


Once the colors were assigned and we verified that there was enough contrast between them with a bar plot containing all samples and Genus DIV

```{r Update the Abs-abund-clean dataset with colors}

#Join both datasets
Abs_abund_clean <- left_join(Abund_clean_rel_0.1,
                  Color_palette_Symbiont_genus,
                  by = c("Symbiont_genus", "Symbiont_genus_simp")) %>%
  #Create a new Clade variable for a better legend
  mutate(Symbiont_genus_combined = str_replace(string = Symbiont_genus_combined, pattern = " - ", replacement = ": "),
         #Create a new Symbiont_genus_color variable that assigns grey for the Others category
    Symbiont_genus_color_others = case_when(Symbiont_genus_others == "Others" ~ "#bbbbbb",
                                     TRUE ~ Symbiont_genus_color),
    
    #Create a new Symbiont_genus_color variable that assigns grey for the Others category
    Symbiont_genus_simp_color_others = case_when(Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "Others" ~ "#bbbbbb",
                                     TRUE ~ Symbiont_genus_simp_color),
    #Create a new Symbiont_genus_combined that includes the Other category
    Symbiont_genus_combined_others = case_when(Symbiont_genus_simp_others  == "Others" ~ "Others",
                                        TRUE ~ Symbiont_genus_combined) )

```

## Obtain a final working dataset

The final step was to clean up the variables inside the final dataset to only include relevant variables for downstream analyses

```{r Final working dataset}

#Create the new dataset
Abundance <- Abs_abund_clean %>%
  #Select the relevant variables and reorder them
  select("Sample_name", "Fragment_label", "Fragment_age", "Location", "Coral_genus", "DNA_method", "Symbiont_genus_simp", "Symbiont_genus_simp_others", "Symbiont_genus", "Symbiont_genus_others", "Abundance", "Rel_abund", "Rel_abund_per", "Symbiont_genus_simp_color", "Symbiont_genus_color", "Symbiont_genus_color_others", "Symbiont_genus_simp_color_others", "Symbiont_genus_combined", "Symbiont_genus_combined_others")

#_______________

#Remove the unused datasets
rm(Abs_abund, Abs_abund_clean, Absolute_abundance, Metadata, Metadata_clean, Abund_clean_rel_0.1, Color_palette_Symbiont_genus)

```

## Variable explanation

All the modifications done to obtain a final dataset where the metadata and absolute abundance of the Post-MED sequences culminated in the dataset: **Abundance**.    

The variables present in the dataset are:    

* **Sample_name:** The name of each fragment created as a code that combines the coral genus (P = Porites, D = Diploastrea), fragment label (See variable **Fragment_label**) and sampling location and DNA extraction method (B = Palau & PowerSoil EDTA, D = Papua New Guinea & PowerSoil, E = Papua New Guinea & PowerSoil EDTA, F = Papua New Guinea & Ancient DNA).     

* **Fragment_label:** Number given to each fragment to represent the age of the fragment. The fragments labelled from 0 - 6 were present for all samples. Fragments labelled as 16 - 18 were only present for *Porites lobata*. Fragments labelled as 20 - 22 were only present for *Diploastrea heliopora*. (0 = Head, 1 = 5-year-old fragment, 2 = 10-year-old fragment, 3 = 15-year-old fragment, 4 = 20-year-old fragment, 5 = 25-year-old fragment, 6 = 30-year-old fragment, 16 = 80-year-old fragment, 17 = 85-year-old fragment, 18 = 90-year-old fragment, 20 = 100-year-old fragment, 21 = 105-year-old fragment, 22 = 110-year-old fragment).    

* **Fragment_age:** Age of each fragment. (See **Fragment_label**)    

* **Location:** Sampling location of each core. Palau and Papua New Guinea (PNG)    

* **Coral_genus:** Genus of the coral skeleton. (Porites = *Porites lobata*, Diplo = *Diploastrea heliopora*)      

* **DNA_method:** Method employed for DNA extraction. (Qiagen PowerSoil Pro kit = PowerSoil, Decalcification and Qiagen PowerSoil Pro kit = PowerSoil_EDTA, Decalcification and Ancient DNA extraction protocol = Ancient_DNA)    

* **Symbiont_genus_simp:** Simplified classification by Clade of each Post-MED sequences. Grouped by Symbiodiniaceae genus/clade (See *Symbiont_genus*)    

* **Symbiont_genus_simp_others:** Simplified classification by "Clade" of each Post-MED sequences. Grouped by Symbiodiniaceae genus/clade. The others category was added for those sequences with a relative abundance lower than 0.1% over all samples.    

* **Symbiont_genus:** Post-MED sequences corresponding to the genus of each Symbiodiniaceae as assigned by SymPortal (following the old Clade classification). For simplicity in the analysis the genera were kept as clades during the analysis. (Clade A = *Symbiodinium*, Clade B = *Breviolum*, Clade C = *Cladocopium*, Clade D = *Durusdinium*)    

* **Symbiont_genus_others:** Post-MED sequences corresponding to the genus of each Symbiodiniaceae as assigned by SymPortal (following the old Clade classification). For simplicity in the analysis the genera were kept as clades during the analysis. (Clade A = *Symbiodinium*, Clade B = *Breviolum*, Clade C = *Cladocopium*, Clade D = *Durusdinium*). The others category was added for those sequences with a relative abundance lower than 0.1% over all samples.    

* **Abundance:** Absolute abundance of the Post-MED sequences of each Symbiodiniaceae genus/clade    

* **Rel_abund:** Relative abundance of the Post-MED sequences of each Symbiodiniaceae genus/clade per sample     

* **Rel_abund_per:** Percentage relative abundance of the Post-MED sequences of each Symbiodiniaceae genus/clade per sample    

* **Symbiont_genus_simp_color:** Colors assigned to each Post-MED sequence grouped by **Symbiont_genus_simp**    

* **Symbiont_genus_color:** Colors assigned to each Post-MED sequence grouped by **Symbiont_genus**   

* **Symbiont_genus_color_others:** Colors assigned to each Post-MED sequence grouped by **Symbiont_genus_others**. The others category was assigned to a gray color.    

* **Symbiont_genus_simp_color_others:** Colors assigned to each Post-MED sequence grouped by **Symbiont_genus_simp_others**. The others category was assigned to a gray color.   

* **Symbiont_genus_combined:** Category created for easier plotting.    

* **Symbiont_genus_combined_others:** Category created for easier plotting including others category.   

# Data analysis

## Aim 1 - DNA method effects

**Assess the effect of three different DNA extraction methods on the reconstructed Symbiodiniaceae communities.**

In order to answer these questions we proceeded to visualize the Genus (DIV) as bar plots, NMDS plots and we evaluated the shared Genus (DIV) between the DNA extraction methods.

### Bar plots

We visualized relative abundance of the post-MED sequences through a stacked bar plot.    

>NOTE: The relative abundance *under* 0.1% was included as the "Others" category

```{r RQ1 - DNA extraction methods - Bar plot}

DNA_method_bar_plot <- Abundance %>%
  #Select the PNG Porites samples
  filter(Location == "PNG" & Coral_genus == "Porites") %>%
  #Create a new DNA_method variable for plotting
  mutate(DNA_method_plot = factor(x = DNA_method, levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA"), labels = c("PowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nPowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nAncient DNA")) ) %>%
  #Select the data for the plot
  ggplot() +
  # First geom_col for the fill aesthetic (stacked bars)
  geom_col(aes(x = Fragment_age, y = Rel_abund, 
               fill = Symbiont_genus_combined_others), 
           color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Hide color here to prevent duplication
  
  # Second geom_col for the color aesthetic (transparent borders)
  geom_col(data = Abundance %>%
  #Select the PNG Porites samples
  filter(Location == "PNG" & Coral_genus == "Porites") %>%
  #Create a new DNA_method variable for plotting
  mutate(DNA_method_plot = factor(x = DNA_method, levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA"), labels = c("PowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nPowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nAncient DNA")),
         
         Symbiont_genus_simp_others_plot = factor(x = case_when(Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "A" ~ "*Symbiodinium*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "B" ~ "*Breviolum*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "C" ~ "*Cladocopium*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "D" ~ "*Durusdinium*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "Others" ~ "Others"), levels = c("*Symbiodinium*", "*Breviolum*", "*Cladocopium*", "*Durusdinium*", "Others")) ) , 
           aes(x = Fragment_age, y = Rel_abund, 
               color = Symbiont_genus_simp_others_plot), 
           fill = NA, alpha = 0, show.legend = TRUE) +
  #Include the scale_manual
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(subset(x = Abundance, subset = Location == "PNG" & Coral_genus == "Porites")$Symbiont_genus_color_others, subset(x = Abundance, subset = Location == "PNG" & Coral_genus == "Porites")$Symbiont_genus_combined_others)) +
  #Include the colors
  scale_color_manual(values = c("transparent", "transparent", "transparent", "transparent", "transparent"),  name = "Symbiodiniaceae\nGenus") +
  #Change the legend
  guides(fill = "none", 
          color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    fill = c("#a5822d", "#3d8590", "#91467f", "#408e5e", "#bbbbbb"),
    color = c("#a5822d", "#3d8590", "#91467f", "#408e5e", "#bbbbbb"),
    alpha = 1)) )  +
  
  #Include facets
  facet_grid(cols = vars(DNA_method_plot),  scales = "free") + 
  #Include a vertical line to indicate the ancient samples
  geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray") +
  #Include plot title
  labs(x = "Fragment age (Years)", y = "Relative abundance", tag = "A") + 
  #Modify the theme
  theme(
    #Eliminate panel grids
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #Change background color
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase axes label text size
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 13), #Before size = 10
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 16), #Before size = 12
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 17), #Before size = 13
    #Change the color of the facet label
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase facet label text size
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16), #Before size = 12
    #Change the legend
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), #Before size = 12
    legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black", size = 15), #Before size = 12
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #Include tags
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.05, 1)
#    plot.tag.location = "plot"
    )

DNA_method_bar_plot

#ggsave(filename = "DNA_method_bar_plot.png", width = 200, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 1800)

```


### NMDS plot

To visualize the community structure we performed a NMDS based on Bray-Curtis distance. The ordination was calculated with the logarithm (+1) of the abundances.

>NOTE: We filtered the relative abundance under 0.1%

```{r RQ1 - DNA extraction methods - NMDS - Data}

#Create the datasets

#Ordination
##Set the random seed
set.seed(15081998)
DNA_method_ord <- metaMDS(comm = Abundance %>% filter(Location == "PNG" & Coral_genus == "Porites" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>% mutate(Abundance_log = log(Abundance + 1), .after = Sample_name) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = Sample_name, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance_log, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name"), dist = "bray", k = 3)

#Extract the data
DNA_method_ord_data <- as.data.frame(scores(DNA_method_ord)$sites) %>%
  #Include the metadata
  
  #Include sample names
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample_name") %>%
  #Include the Location, Species and DNA_Method
  mutate(Coral_genus = factor(case_when(grepl(pattern = "^P", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Porites",
                           grepl(pattern = "^D", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Diploastrea"), levels = c("Porites", "Diploastrea")),
         
         DNA_method = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "B$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil_EDTA",
                                grepl(pattern = "D$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil",
                                grepl(pattern = "E$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil_EDTA",
                                grepl(pattern = "F$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Ancient_DNA"), levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA")),
         
         Location = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "B$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Palau",
                              grepl(pattern = "D$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG"), levels = c("Palau", "PNG")),
         
          Fragment_label = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^[PD]0", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Head",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]1[^678]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]2[^012]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]3", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "3",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]4", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "4",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]5", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "5",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]6", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "6",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P16", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P17", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P18", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D20", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D21", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D22", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3"), levels = c("Head", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3")),
         
         #Fragment age
         Fragment_age = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^[PD]0", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "0",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]1[^678]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "5",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]2[^012]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "10",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]3", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "15",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]4", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "20",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]5", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "25",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]6", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "30",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P16", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "80",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P17", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "85",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P18", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "90"), levels = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30", "80", "85", "90")) )


#_____________________________________________________________________________________________ 

#Create the color palette

ggnested::extract_palette(DNA_method_ord_data %>%
  #Select the data
  ggnested::ggnested(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, 
             main_group = Coral_genus, 
             sub_group = Fragment_age),
             main_palette = c("#0077b6"),
           gradient_type = "tints") +
  #Select the type of plot
  geom_point(aes(shape = DNA_method), size = 6, show.legend = F) +
  #Change the theme
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",  color = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom") )

#Create the color dataset
DNA_method_ord_colors <- DNA_method_ord_data %>%
  #Include a new variable for the plot
  mutate(Fragment_age_color = case_when(Fragment_age == "0" ~ "white",
                                        Fragment_age == "5" ~ "#C0E5FA",
                                        Fragment_age == "10" ~ "#A7DAF5",
                                        Fragment_age == "15" ~ "#90CEF0",
                                        Fragment_age == "20" ~ "#78C3EB",
                                        Fragment_age == "25" ~ "#60B7E6",
                                        Fragment_age == "30" ~ "#48ACE1",
                                        Fragment_age == "80" ~ "#30A0DC",
                                        Fragment_age == "85" ~ "#1895D7",
                                        Fragment_age == "90" ~ "#008AD3"))


```

### PERMANOVA

```{r RQ1 - DNA extraction methods - PERMANOVA - Betadisper - Pairwise}

#Create the datasets
##Distance matrix
DNA_method_dist <- vegdist(x = Abundance %>% 
  #Obtain only Porites for PNG over 0.1%
  filter(Location == "PNG" & Coral_genus == "Porites" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>% 
  #Change the data structure: Rows are samples, columns are Post-MED sequences or Coral_genus DIV
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Sample_name, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  #Assign sample names as row names for the vegdist function
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name"),
  method = "bray")

##Metadata for distance matrix
DNA_method_dist_metadata <- Abundance %>% 
  #Obtain only Porites for PNG over 0.1%
  filter(Location == "PNG" & Coral_genus == "Porites" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>% 
  #Change the data structure: Rows are samples, columns are Post-MED sequences or Coral_genus DIV
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Sample_name, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  #Create a new metadata column with the DNA_methods
  mutate(DNA_method = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "D$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil_EDTA",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Ancient_DNA"), levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA")), .after = "Sample_name",
         
         Fragment_label = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^[PD]0", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Head",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]1[^678]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]2[^012]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]3", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "3",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]4", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "4",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]5", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "5",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]6", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "6",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P16", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P17", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P18", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3"), levels = c("Head", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3"))) %>%
  #Assign sample names as row names for the adonis function
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name")

#_____________________________________________________________________________

#Run the PERMANOVA

#Set the random seed
set.seed(15081998)
#Run the PERMANOVA - Only for DNA methods
adonis2(formula = DNA_method_dist ~ DNA_method, data = DNA_method_dist_metadata, permutations = 9999)

#________________________________________________________________________________________________

#Test for multivariate homogeneity of variances
##Betadisper - general
anova(betadisper(DNA_method_dist, group = DNA_method_dist_metadata$DNA_method))

#________________________________________________________________________________________________

#Posthoc PERMANOVA
set.seed(15081998)
pairwise.adonis(x = DNA_method_dist, factors = DNA_method_dist_metadata$DNA_method)


```


### UpSet plot

In order to inspect the number of shared Genus (DIV) between each DNA extraction method, an Upset plot was performed.    

To create the UpSet plot we first need to group the data by DNA method (and Symbiodiniaceae) so that we can add the abundances per DIV. Then we create a logical variable based on the abundance of a DIV within each DNA extraction method.    

For formatting the data we have to format the dataset so that we have the DNA method as columns, the DIVs as rows and the logical variable as the data.

```{r RQ1 - DNA extraction methods - UpSet}

##Go from long to wide format
DNA_Method_Upset_data <- as.data.frame(t(Abundance %>%
  #Filter to obtain the DNA extraction methods
  filter(Location == "PNG", Coral_genus == "Porites") %>%
  #Filter out DIVs with an abundance lower than 0.01
  filter(Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>%
  #Group the data by DNA method
  group_by(DNA_method, Symbiont_genus) %>%
  #Calculate the sum the of the abundances
  summarize(Total_seqs = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  #Create a new Abundance variable that is only presence/abscense
  mutate(Abundance_logical = case_when(Total_seqs > 0 ~ 1,
                                       TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
  #Change the structure of the data
  pivot_wider(id_cols = DNA_method, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance_logical, values_fill = 0) )) %>%
  #rownames to column
  rownames_to_column(var = "Symbiont_genus") %>%
  #row to column names
  rename(PowerSoil = V1, PowerSoil_EDTA = V2, Ancient_DNA = V3) %>%
  #Eliminate the first row
  filter(Symbiont_genus != "DNA_method") %>%
  #Transfrom data as numeric
  mutate(PowerSoil = as.numeric(PowerSoil), PowerSoil_EDTA = as.numeric(PowerSoil_EDTA), Ancient_DNA = as.numeric(Ancient_DNA)) %>%
  #Rename the variables for the plot
  rename("PowerSoil Pro" = "PowerSoil", "Decalcification\nPowerSoil Pro" = "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Decalcification\nAncient DNA" = "Ancient_DNA")

#_______________________________________________________________________

DNA_Method_Upset_plot <- upset(data = DNA_Method_Upset_data, 
      #Groups
      intersect = c("PowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nPowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nAncient DNA"),
      #Change group names (x axis)
      name = "DNA extraction methods",
      #Modify the stripes
      stripes = upset_stripes(geom = geom_segment(size = 15), colors = c("white", "gray90")),
      #Modify the intersection matrix
      matrix = intersection_matrix(geom = geom_point(size = 7), segment = geom_segment(linewidth = 2)),
      #Modify the set size label
      set_sizes = (upset_set_size() + labs(y = "Number of post-MED\nsequences") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black") )  
                   ),
      #Modify the intersection size area
      base_annotations = list("Intersection size" = intersection_size(text = list(size = 6)) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"))
                              ),
      #Group the plot so that it is easier to combine with other plots
      wrap = T,
      #Change the theme elements
      themes = 
        
      upset_modify_themes(list("intersections_matrix" = theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
                                                              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
                                                              panel.grid = element_blank()),
                               
                               "intersection_size" = theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
                                                             panel.grid = element_blank()) )) )

DNA_Method_Upset_plot

#ggsave(plot = DNA_Method_Upset_0.1_plot_ComplexUpset, filename = "DNA_method_Upset.png", width = 200, height = 180, units = "mm", dpi = 1800)

```

## Aim 2 - Species x Location effects

**Assess the effect of three different DNA extraction methods on the reconstructed Symbiodiniaceae communities.**

In order to answer these questions we proceeded to visualize the Genus (DIV) as bar plots, NMDS plots and we evaluated the shared Genus (DIV) between the DNA extraction methods.

### Bar plots

We visualized relative abundance of the post-MED sequences through a stacked bar plot.  

>NOTE: The relative abundance *under* 0.1% was included as the "Others" category

```{r RQ2 - Symbiont changes - Bar plot}

Location_species_bar_plot <- Abundance %>%
  #Select the PNG Porites samples
  filter(DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA") %>% 
  #Create a new DNA_method variable for plotting
  mutate(DNA_method_plot = factor(x = DNA_method, levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA"), labels = c("PowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nPowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nAncient DNA"))) %>%
  #Create a new species and Location variable for the plot
  mutate(Location_plot = factor(x = case_when(Location == "PNG" ~ "Papua New Guinea",
                                   TRUE ~ Location), levels = c("Palau", "Papua New Guinea")),
         
         Coral_genus_plot = factor(x = case_when(Coral_genus == "Porites" ~ "*Porites lobata*",
                                Coral_genus == "Diploastrea" ~ "*Diploastrea heliopora*"),
                             levels = c("*Porites lobata*", "*Diploastrea heliopora*")),
         
         Fragment_label_plot = factor(x = case_when(Fragment_label == "Head" ~ "0",
                                                    TRUE ~ Fragment_label),
                                      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3"),
                                      labels = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3")) ) %>%
  #Select the data for the plot
  ggplot() +
  
  # First geom_col for the fill aesthetic (stacked bars)
  geom_col(aes(x = Fragment_label_plot, y = Rel_abund_per, 
               fill = Symbiont_genus_combined_others), 
           color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Hide color here to prevent duplication
  
  # Second geom_col for the color aesthetic (transparent borders)
  geom_col(data = Abundance %>%
  #Select the DNA method
  filter(DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA") %>%
  #Create a new DNA_method variable for plotting
  mutate(DNA_method_plot = factor(x = DNA_method, levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA"), labels = c("PowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nPowerSoil Pro", "Decalcification\nAncient DNA")),
         
         Symbiont_genus_simp_others_plot = factor(x = case_when(Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "A" ~ "*Symbiodinium*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "B" ~ "*Breviolum*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "C" ~ "*Cladocopium*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "D" ~ "*Durusdinium*",
                                                       Symbiont_genus_simp_others == "Others" ~ "Others"), levels = c("*Symbiodinium*", "*Breviolum*", "*Cladocopium*", "*Durusdinium*", "Others")),
         
         Fragment_label_plot = factor(x = case_when(Fragment_label == "Head" ~ "0",
                                                    TRUE ~ Fragment_label),
                                      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3"),
                                      labels = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3")) ) %>%
    #Create a new species and Location variable for the plot
  mutate(Location_plot = factor(x = case_when(Location == "PNG" ~ "Papua New Guinea",
                                   TRUE ~ Location), levels = c("Palau", "Papua New Guinea")),
         
         Coral_genus_plot = factor(x = case_when(Coral_genus == "Porites" ~ "*Porites lobata*",
                                Coral_genus == "Diploastrea" ~ "*Diploastrea heliopora*"),
                             levels = c("*Porites lobata*", "*Diploastrea heliopora*"))) , 
  
           aes(x = Fragment_label_plot, y = Rel_abund_per, 
               color = Symbiont_genus_simp_others_plot), 
           fill = NA, alpha = 0, show.legend = TRUE) +
  
  #Include the scale_manual
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(as.character(subset(x = Abundance, subset = DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA")$Symbiont_genus_color_others), as.character(subset(x = Abundance, subset = DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA")$Symbiont_genus_combined_others))) +
  #Include the colors
  scale_color_manual(values = c("transparent", "transparent", "transparent", "transparent", "transparent"),  name = "Symbiodiniaceae genus") +
  #Change the legend
  guides(fill = "none", 
          color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    fill = c("#a5822d", "#3d8590", "#91467f", "#408e5e", "#bbbbbb"),
    color = c("#a5822d", "#3d8590", "#91467f", "#408e5e", "#bbbbbb"),
    alpha = 1)) )  +
  #Include facets
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Coral_genus_plot), cols = vars(Location_plot), scales = "free") + 
  #Include a vertical line to indicate the ancient samples
  geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray") +
  #Include plot title
  labs(x = "Fragment age (Years)", y = "Relative abundance") + 
  #Modify the theme
  theme(
    #Eliminate panel grids
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #Change background color
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase axes label text size
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "white", size = 1), #Before size = 10
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 18), #Before size = 12
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 18), #Before size = 13
    #Change the color of the facet label
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase facet label text size
    strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black", size = 18), #Before size = 12
    #Change the legend
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), #Before size = 14
    legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black", size = 15), #Before size = 13
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #Include tags
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.location = "plot"
    )
```

### NMDS plots

To visualize the community structure we performed a NMDS based on Bray-Curtis distances of the post-MED sequences.     

>NOTE: We filtered the relative abundance under 0.1%

```{r RQ2 - Location x Species - NMDS - All together}

#Create the datasets

#Ordination
##Set the random seed
set.seed(15081998)
Location_species_ord_all <- metaMDS(comm = Abundance %>% filter(DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = Sample_name, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name"), dist = "bray", k = 3)

#Extract the data
Location_species_ord_all_data <- as.data.frame(scores(Location_species_ord_all)$sites)

##Include the metadata
Location_species_ord_all_data <- Location_species_ord_all_data %>%
  #Include sample names
  rownames_to_column(var = "Sample_name") %>%
  #Include the Location, Species and DNA_Method
  mutate(
    
         Coral_genus = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^P", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Porites",
                           grepl(pattern = "^D", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Diploastrea"), levels = c("Porites", "Diploastrea")),
    
         
         Coral_genus_fill_aes = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^P", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Porites",
                           grepl(pattern = "^D", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Diploastrea"), levels = c("Porites", "Diploastrea"), labels = c(21, 24)),
         
         
         #DNA extraction method
         DNA_method = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "B$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil_EDTA",
                              grepl(pattern = "D$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PowerSoil_EDTA",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Ancient_DNA"), levels = c("PowerSoil", "PowerSoil_EDTA", "Ancient_DNA")),
         
         
         #Sampling location
         Location = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "B$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Palau",
                              grepl(pattern = "D$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG"), levels = c("Palau", "PNG")),

                              grepl(pattern = "D$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG"), levels = c("Palau", "PNG"), labels = c(21,24)),

                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]1[^678]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]2[^012]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]3", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "3",

                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]6", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "6",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P16", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P17", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P18", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D20", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D21", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D22", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3"), levels = c("Head", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3")),
         
         #Fragment age
         Fragment_age = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^[PD]0", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "0",

                                        Coral_genus_Frag_age == "Diploastrea - 25" ~ "#C75D5D",
                                        Coral_genus_Frag_age == "Diploastrea - 30" ~	"#BC4545",
                                        Coral_genus_Frag_age == "Diploastrea - 100" ~	"#B12E2E",
                                        Coral_genus_Frag_age == "Diploastrea - 105" ~	"#A61717",
                                        Coral_genus_Frag_age == "Diploastrea - 110" ~	"#9B0000"))

#_____________________________________

#Plot the nMDS

#NMDS1 - NMDS2

Location_species_ord_all_plot <- left_join(Location_species_ord_all_data, Location_species_ord_all_data_colors, by = c("Coral_genus", "Fragment_age")) %>%
  #Include new variable for plotting
  unite(col = "Location_genus", Location, Coral_genus, sep = "_", remove = F) %>%
  #Include plotting variables
  mutate(Location_plot = factor(x = Location, levels = c("Palau", "PNG"), labels = c("Palau", "Papua New Guinea")),
         Facet_label = "All data") %>%
  #Select the data for plotting
  ggplot(aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  #Select the type of plot
  geom_point(aes(fill = Coral_genus_Frag_age, shape = Location_plot, color = Coral_genus_Frag_age), size = 10, show.legend = T, stroke = 1.5) + 
  #Include the shape selection
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24), name = "Sampling\nLocation") + 
  #Include the elipses
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = Location_genus), linetype = "dashed", show.legend = F,
               #color = c("#0077b6", "#780000")
               ) + 
  #Include the color selection
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(as.character(left_join(Location_species_ord_all_data, Location_species_ord_all_data_colors, by = c("Coral_genus", "Fragment_age"))$Fragment_age_color), as.character(left_join(Location_species_ord_all_data, Location_species_ord_all_data_colors, by = c("Coral_genus", "Fragment_age"))$Coral_genus_Frag_age)) ) +
  #Include the color selection for borders
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(left_join(Location_species_ord_all_data, Location_species_ord_all_data_colors, by = c("Coral_genus", "Fragment_age"))$Coral_genus_color, left_join(Location_species_ord_all_data, Location_species_ord_all_data_colors, by = c("Coral_genus", "Fragment_age"))$Coral_genus_Frag_age) ) +
  #Choose which legends appear
  guides(color = "none",
         fill = "none") +
    #Include the Stress inside the plot
  annotate(geom = "text", x = -0.35, y = 0.8, label = paste("3D-Stress:", signif(Location_species_ord_all$stress, 3)), size = 6) +
  #Include the Stress value
#  labs(subtitle = paste("3D-Stress:", signif(Location_species_ord_all$stress, 3))) + 
  #Include facet grid name
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Facet_label)) +
  #Modify the theme
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",  color = "black"),
        #Modify the caption size
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
        #Modify the axis text
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
        #Modify the legend elements
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), #Before size = 12
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16), #Before size = 12
        #Include tags
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
        plot.tag.location = "plot",
        #Change the color of the facet label
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        #Increase facet label text size
        strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(color = "black", size = 18)
        )
```

### PERMANOVA

We will perform a PERMANOVA and test the assumptions to figure out if there are significantly different or not.

```{r RQ2 - Differences between location and species - PERMANOVA}

#Create the datasets
##Distance matrix
Location_species_dist <- vegdist(x = Abundance %>% 
  #Obtain only Porites for PNG over 0.1%
  filter(DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>% 
  #Change the data structure: Rows are samples, columns are Post-MED sequences or Coral_genus DIV
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Sample_name, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  #Assign sample names as row names for the vegdist function
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name"),
  method = "bray")

##Metadata for distance matrix
Location_species_dist_metadata <- Abundance %>% 
  #Obtain only Porites for PNG over 0.1%
  filter(DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>% 
  #Change the data structure: Rows are samples, columns are Post-MED sequences or Coral_genus DIV
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Sample_name, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  #Create a new metadata column with the DNA_methods
  mutate(Coral_genus = factor(x = case_when(
                           grepl(pattern = "^P", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Porites",
                           grepl(pattern = "^D", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Diploastrea"), levels = c("Porites", "Diploastrea")),
         
         #Sampling location
         Location = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "B$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Palau",
                              grepl(pattern = "D$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "E$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG",
                              grepl(pattern = "F$", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "PNG"), levels = c("Palau", "PNG")),
         
         Fragment_label = factor(x = case_when(grepl(pattern = "^[PD]0", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Head",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]1[^678]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]2[^012]", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]3", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "3",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]4", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "4",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]5", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "5",
                                           grepl(pattern = "^[PD]6", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "6",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P16", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P17", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "P18", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3",
                                            grepl(pattern = "D20", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc1",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D21", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc2",
                                           grepl(pattern = "D22", x = Sample_name, ignore.case = T) ~ "Anc3"), levels = c("Head", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3"))) %>%
  #Assign sample names as row names for the adonis function
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name")

#_____________________________________________________________________________

#Run the PERMANOVA

#Set the random seed
set.seed(15081998)
#Run the PERMANOVA - Only for DNA methods
adonis2(formula = Location_species_dist ~ Location * Coral_genus, data = Location_species_dist_metadata, permutations = 9999, by = "terms")


#________________________________________________________________________________________________

#Test for multivariate homogeneity of variances
##Betadisper - general
anova(betadisper(Location_species_dist, group = with(Location_species_dist_metadata, interaction(Location, Coral_genus)) ))
##Betadisper based on permutations
set.seed(15081998)
permutest(betadisper(Location_species_dist, group = with(Location_species_dist_metadata, interaction(Location, Coral_genus)) ))
##Pairwise betadisper
TukeyHSD(betadisper(Location_species_dist, group = with(Location_species_dist_metadata, interaction(Location, Coral_genus)) ))

#________________________________________________________________________________________________

#Posthoc PERMANOVA
set.seed(15081998)
pairwise.adonis(x = Location_species_dist, factors = with(Location_species_dist_metadata, interaction(Location, Coral_genus)))



```

### Distance-Decay plot

```{r RQ2 - Distance-Decay plot - Palau - Porites - Decade}

#Community

#Create the dataset
Palau_Porites_decade <- Abundance %>%
  #Filter to obtain Porites from Palau
  filter(Location == "Palau", Coral_genus == "Porites" & DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>% 
  #Filter to obtain only recent samples
  filter(!grepl(pattern = "Anc", x = Fragment_label)) %>%
  #Change the data structure
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Sample_name, names_from = Symbiont_genus, values_from = Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  #Remove sample names
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name")

#Compute the distances
Palau_Porites_decade_dist <- as.vector(1 - vegdist(x = Palau_Porites_decade, method = "bray"))

#___________________________________________________________________________________

# Core distance

#Create the dataset
Palau_Porites_decade_core <- Abundance %>%
  #Filter to obtain Porites from Palau
  filter(Location == "Palau", Coral_genus == "Porites" & DNA_method == "PowerSoil_EDTA" & Rel_abund_per > 0.1) %>%
  #Filter to obtain only recent samples
  filter(!grepl(pattern = "Anc", x = Fragment_label)) %>%
  #Select only the unique core names and ages
  distinct(Sample_name, Fragment_age) %>% 
  #Remove sample names
  column_to_rownames(var = "Sample_name") %>%
  #Change to numeric variable
  mutate(Fragment_age = as.numeric(as.character(Fragment_age)))


#Compute the distances for the cores
Palau_Porites_decade_core_dist <- as.vector(vegdist(x = Palau_Porites_decade_core, method = "euclidean"))

#___________________________________________

#Create a dataframe
Palau_Porites_decade_dist_decay_data <- data.frame(Core_distance = Palau_Porites_decade_core_dist, Community_sim = Palau_Porites_decade_dist)

Palau_Porites_decade_dist_decay_lm_sum

#Compute a Mantel test

mantel(xdis = (1 - vegdist(x = Palau_Porites_decade, method = "bray")), 
       ydis = vegdist(x = Palau_Porites_decade_core, method = "euclidean"),

  #Change the labels
```

## Aim 3: Dynamics related to past environmental changes   

**Probe differences in the reconstruction dynamics between two massive growing coral species in the context of past potential heat stress events.**    

In order to answer this data, we will start by processing the bleaching data taken from the NOAA Coral Reef Watch

https://coralreefwatch.noaa.gov/product/5km/index.php#data_access

Data download website (as csv): https://pae-paha.pacioos.hawaii.edu/erddap/griddap/dhw_5km.html

Once the data was downloaded as a csv file and joined into one dataframe we proceeded to clean up the data (Separate and filter the dates according to the sampling dates)    

Core Metadata:

|   Core ID  	| Location 	| Sampling date 	| Species 	| Dimensions (cm) 	| Linear extension rate (mm/year) 	|
|:----------:	|:--------:	|:-------------:	|:-------:	|:---------------:	|:-------------------------------:	|
|   I23 S2   	|    PNG   	|   2017-11-06  	| Porites 	|    1.8 - 2.0    	|               9.9               	|
| I23 S2 c18 	|    PNG   	|   2017-11-06  	|  Diplo  	|    0.7 - 0.8    	|               4.1               	|
| I26 S1 c26 	|   Palau  	|   2018-01-06  	| Porites 	|    1.6 - 3.6    	|               9.4               	|
| I26 S1 c27 	|   Palau  	|   2018-01-06  	|  Diplo  	|    1.0 - 1.5    	|               5.1               	|


```{r RQ3 - NOAA CRW SST - Clean}


#Create a Core calcification metadata file
Core_metadata <- data.frame(Location = c("PNG", "PNG", "Palau", "Palau"),
                            Sampling_date = c(as.Date("2017-11-06"), as.Date("2017-11-06"), as.Date("2018-01-06"), as.Date("2018-01-06")),
                            Coral_genus = c("Porites", "Diplo", "Porites", "Diplo"),
                            Dimension_right_cm = c(1.8, 0.7, 1.6, 1.0),
                            Dimension_left_cm = c(2.0, 0.8, 3.6, 1.5),
                            Linear_ext_rate_mm_year = c(9.9, 4.1, 9.4, 5.1)) %>%
  #Group the data
  group_by(Location, Sampling_date, Coral_genus, Linear_ext_rate_mm_year) %>%
  #Calculate the age of the head fragments
  summarize(Avg_dimension_cm = mean(Dimension_right_cm, Dimension_left_cm),
         
         Avg_dimension_mm = Avg_dimension_cm * 10,
         
         Fragment_age_years = (Avg_dimension_mm/Linear_ext_rate_mm_year))

Core_metadata

#_________________________________________________________________________________________

#Data for Palau

NOAA_CRW_Palau <- NOAA_CRW %>%
  #Create new varaibles based on the time variable
  separate(col = "Time_UTC", into = c("Year", "Month", "Day_time"), sep = "-", remove = F) %>%
  #Modify the day variable
  separate(Day_time, into = c("Day", "Time"), sep = "T", remove = T) %>%
  #Modify the type of data
  mutate(across(c("Year", "Month", "Day", "Latitude_North", "Longitude_East", "Bleaching_alert_area", "Degree_heating_week_Celsius_Week", "Coral_bleaching_hotspot_Celsius", "SST_Celsius", "SST_Anomaly_Celsius"), .fns = as.numeric)) %>%
  #Separate date and time info
  separate(col = "Time_UTC", into = c("Date", "Time"), sep = "T", remove = T) %>%
  #Modify the variable type
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  #Apply the filter
  filter(Location == "Palau" & Date <= "2018-01-06") %>%
  #Include  a variable that has the 5 - year intervals per sample
  mutate(Core_years = case_when(Date <= "2018-01-06" & Date > "2016-01-06" ~ "0",
                                Date <= "2016-01-06" & Date > "2011-01-06" ~ "5",
                                Date <= "2011-01-06" & Date > "2006-01-06" ~ "10",
                                Date <= "2006-01-06" & Date > "2001-01-06" ~ "15",
                                Date <= "2001-01-06" & Date > "1996-01-06" ~ "20",
                                Date <= "1996-01-06" & Date > "1991-01-06" ~ "25",
                                Date <= "1991-01-06" & Date > "1986-01-06" ~ "30"))

#___________________________________________________________________

#Data for PNG

NOAA_CRW_PNG <- NOAA_CRW %>%
  #Create new varaibles based on the time variable
  separate(col = "Time_UTC", into = c("Year", "Month", "Day_time"), sep = "-", remove = F) %>%
  #Modify the day variable
  separate(Day_time, into = c("Day", "Time"), sep = "T", remove = T) %>%
  #Modify the type of data
  mutate(across(c("Year", "Month", "Day", "Latitude_North", "Longitude_East", "Bleaching_alert_area", "Degree_heating_week_Celsius_Week", "Coral_bleaching_hotspot_Celsius", "SST_Celsius", "SST_Anomaly_Celsius"), .fns = as.numeric)) %>%
  #Separate date and time info
  separate(col = "Time_UTC", into = c("Date", "Time"), sep = "T", remove = T) %>%
  #Modify the variable type
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date, tz = "UTC")) %>%
  #Apply the filter
  filter(Location == "PNG" & Date < "2017-11-07")  %>%
  #Include  a variable that has the 5 - year intervals per sample
  mutate(Core_years = case_when(Date <= "2017-11-06" & Date > "2015-11-06" ~ "0",
                                Date <= "2015-11-06" & Date > "2010-11-06" ~ "5",
                                Date <= "2010-11-06" & Date > "2005-11-06" ~ "10",
                                Date <= "2005-11-06" & Date > "2000-11-06" ~ "15",
                                Date <= "2000-11-06" & Date > "1995-11-06" ~ "20",
                                Date <= "1995-11-06" & Date > "1990-11-06" ~ "25",
                                Date <= "1990-11-06" & Date > "1985-11-06" ~ "30"))

#___________________________________________________________________


NOAA_CRW_clean <- bind_rows(NOAA_CRW_Palau, NOAA_CRW_PNG) %>%
  #Rename the time period variable
  rename(Time_period = Time.period) %>%
  #Change the data format
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))


```

Now we will investigate the bleaching alerts

```{r RQ3 - NOAA CRW SST - Number of days with bleaching alerts - Numbers and plots}

#Total number of bleaching alerts per location
NOAA_CRW_clean %>%
  #Obtain bleaching alerts 
  filter(Bleaching_alert_area > 0 & !is.na(Core_years)) %>%
  #Group the data
  group_by(Location, Bleaching_alert_area) %>%
  #Obtain the total number of bleaching alerts in the time series
  summarize(Total_Bleaching_alerts = n())

#Number of bleaching alerts per location and Core_year
NOAA_CRW_clean %>%
  #Obtain bleaching alerts 
  filter(Bleaching_alert_area > 0 & !is.na(Core_years)) %>%
  #Group the data
  group_by(Location, Core_years, Bleaching_alert_area) %>%
  #Obtain the total number of bleaching in the time series
  summarize(Total_Bleaching_alerts = n()) %>%
  #Ungroup the data
  ungroup() %>%
  #Create a new variable for normalization
  mutate(Bleaching_alert_year_interval = case_when(Core_years == "0" ~ Total_Bleaching_alerts/2,
                                                   TRUE ~ Total_Bleaching_alerts/5))

  
  
#_______________________________________________________________________

#Number of bleaching alerts per location and Core_year

##Joined plot

Bleaching_alert_joined <- NOAA_CRW_clean %>%
  #Obtain bleaching alerts 
  filter(Bleaching_alert_area > 0 & !is.na(Core_years)) %>%
  #Group the data
  group_by(Location, Core_years, Bleaching_alert_area) %>%
  #Obtain the total number of bleaching in the time series
  summarize(Total_Bleaching_alerts = n()) %>%
  #Ungroup the data
  ungroup() %>%
  #Include a new variable for the plot
  mutate(Core_years = factor(x = Core_years, levels = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30")#, labels = c("2018\n(0)", "2018 9- 2013\n(5)", "2013 - 2008\n(10)", "2008 - 2003\n(15)", "2003 - 1998\n(20)", "1998 - 1993\n(25", "1993 - 1988\n(30)")
                             ),
         
         Bleaching_alert_area = factor(x = Bleaching_alert_area, levels = c("1", "2", "3")),
         
         Location_2 = case_when(Location == "PNG" ~ "Papua New Guinea",
                                TRUE ~ Location)) %>%
  #Create a new variable for normalization
  mutate(Bleaching_alert_year_interval = case_when(Core_years == "0" ~ Total_Bleaching_alerts/2,
                                                   TRUE ~ Total_Bleaching_alerts/5)) %>%
  #Select the data for plotting
  ggplot(aes(x = Core_years, y = Bleaching_alert_year_interval, fill = Bleaching_alert_area)) +
  #Select the type of plot
  geom_col() +
  #Change the colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ffb703", "#fb8500", "red3"), name = "Bleaching alert") +
  #Change the x axis breacks
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("0", "5", "10", "15", "20", "25", "30", "Anc1", "Anc2", "Anc3")) +
  #Include a vertical line to indicate the ancient samples
  geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray") +
  #Include facets
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Location_2)) +
  #Change the axes labels
    labs(x = "Fragment age (Years)", y = "Days with bleaching\nalerts per years") +
  #Modify the theme
  theme(
    #Eliminate panel grids
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #Change background color
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase axes label text size
    #axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16), #Original size = 12
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18), #Original size = 12
    #Change the color of the facet label
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase facet label text size
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 18), #Original size = 12
    #Change the legend
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 18), #Original size = 12
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 15), #Original size = 9
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 18), #Original size = 12
    legend.key = element_rect(color = "white"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 18), #Original size = 12
    legend.position = "bottom"
    )


Bleaching_alert_joined
```
