```{r RQ3 - NOAA CRW SST - Plot}

Fig_S4 <- NOAA_CRW_clean %>%
  #Create a new variable for the plot
  mutate(Location_plot = case_when(Location == "PNG" ~ "Papua New Guinea", 
                                   TRUE ~ Location)) %>%
  #Filter out the non-used data
  filter(!is.na(Core_years)) %>%
  #Select the data
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = SST_Celsius)) + 
  #Select the type of plot
  geom_line() +
  #Include bleaching alert
  geom_rug(aes(x = Date, y = 32, color = Bleaching_alert_area), data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% filter(Bleaching_alert_area > 0 & !is.na(Core_years)) %>% mutate(Bleaching_alert_area = factor(x = Bleaching_alert_area, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))), size = 3, show.legend = T, sides = "t") + 
  #Assign the colors
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ffb703", "#fb8500", "red3"), name = "Bleaching alert") +
  #Include to improve visualization
  geom_rug(aes(x = Date, y = 31, color = Bleaching_alert_area), color = "#ffb703", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% filter(Bleaching_alert_area == 1 & !is.na(Core_years)), sides = "t") + 
  #Include to improve visualization
  geom_rug(aes(x = Date, y = 31, color = Bleaching_alert_area), color = "#fb8500", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% filter(Bleaching_alert_area == 2 & !is.na(Core_years)), size = 3, sides = "t") + 
  #Include to improve visualization
  geom_rug(aes(x = Date, y = 31, color = Bleaching_alert_area), color = "red3", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% filter(Bleaching_alert_area == 2 & !is.na(Core_years)), size = 3, sides = "t") + 
  #Include vertical lines indicating the period of each sample
  ##Palau
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2018-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "Palau")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2013-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "Palau")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2008-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "Palau")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2003-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "Palau")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("1998-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "Palau")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("1993-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "Palau")) +
  ##PNG
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2017-11-06")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "PNG")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2012-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "PNG")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2007-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "PNG")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("2002-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "PNG")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("1997-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "PNG")) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = as.Date("1992-01-01")), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "darkgray", data = NOAA_CRW_clean %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>% filter(Location == "PNG")) +
  #Control the axis breaks
  scale_x_date(breaks = c(as.Date("1987-12-01"), as.Date("1992-01-01"), as.Date("1997-01-01"), as.Date("2002-01-01"), as.Date("2007-01-01"), as.Date("2012-01-01"), as.Date("2018-01-01")), date_labels = "%Y" ) +
  #Include facets by locations
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Location), labeller = labeller(Location = c("PNG" = "Papua New Guinea", "Palau" = "Palau"))) + 
  #Modify axes labels
  labs(y = "Daily sea surface temperature (°C)", x = "Year") + 
  #Modify the theme
  theme(
    #Eliminate panel grids
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #Change background color
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase axes label text size
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    #Change the color of the facet label
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    #Increase facet label text size
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    #Change the legend
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key = element_rect(color = "white")
    )
```
